title: Oscars: Germany Selects Sandra Wollner’s ‘Everytime’ for International Feature Race
content: Sandra Wollner’s “Everytime” has been selected as Germany’s entry for the Academy Award for best international feature film. The film’s synopsis reads as follows: The last photograph Jessie took shows the sun over Berlin. It hangs there as if nothing had happened. But Ella has lost her daughter.
